title: Automorphism groups of rigid complete intersections
summary: We study the automorphism groups of complete intersections of hypersurfaces of strictly increasing degrees in projective space. Under a combinatorial rigidity condition on the tuple of defining polynomials, we show that every automorphism of the complete intersection extends to an automorphism of each defining hypersurface, so that its automorphism group is the intersection of the automorphism groups of the defining hypersurfaces.
